reviewPolicy: Owner's latest steering: actual screenshot geometry, camera and landmark scale take precedence over style; initial decorative drafts rejected and replaced. All final images visually reviewed. Native framing retained instead of cropping landmarks to force 16:9.

assets.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Make a faithful high-quality illustration of IMAGE 1, the actual in-game screenshot, in a crisp voxel/pixel-textured rendering style. IMAGE 1 is the edit target and ABSOLUTE FACTUAL AUTHORITY. Match its SAME CAMERA, viewing direction, framing, perspective, relative scale and exact placement of all visible landmarks. Preserve the exact visible building count, building shapes and roof colors, mine footprint and relative size, block types and patchwork, paths, water, terrain contours, sparse areas and original palette. Do not redesign, rearrange, beautify the map with new objects, add vegetation, houses, rivers, roads, lamp posts, crates, extra architecture or other decoration. Do not invent scenery outside the screenshot. Images 2 and 3 show rendering style ONLY: crisp voxel surfaces, fine pixel material textures and soft readable illumination; do NOT copy any objects, geometry, vegetation, composition or colors from them. Only improve surface rendering, clarity and subtle lighting of the existing screenshot geometry. Retain the original location's character and believable game appearance, with enough fill light to read the mine, no bloom or glare. Wide 16:9 destination image, no UI/text/labels/logos/watermarks, remove visible characters and creatures but do not replace them with new objects. The final image must be immediately recognizable as the same exact map and camera, not a newly designed interpretation.
Recognize and preserve: Prison: actual central square blue-water fountain, pale path grid, large sand/gravel/earth mining rectangle behind it, low orange-roofed service buildings at image edges. Keep the screenshot's exact spacing and existing trees; no additional flower beds or lamps.
assets.visualCheck: PASS faithful replacement: exact screenshot-like camera/framing, fountain courtyard and rear mine proportions, cream path grid, original edge buildings and sparse lawn/tree groups; removed invented dense flowers/lamps from draft.
